models.notes: genieacs-relay paths/vendors/zte.yaml lists product_class F660 (OUI 001141) and states ZTE uses the X_CT-COM_* / X_ZTE-COM_* subtrees for optical stats. optical.go reads GPON stats from InternetGatewayDevice.X_CT-COM_GponInterfaceConfig.Stats (TxPower, RxPower, BiasCurrent). Forum topic 5925 shows an F660 PPPoE Username declared on WANConnectionDevice.2 - instance index varies per device, catalog uses WANConnectionDevice.1 (the default.yaml pppoe template).

optical.go documents the field layout observed on a real F670L running V9.0.10P1N12A under InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.1.X_ZTE-COM_WANPONInterfaceConfig: BiasCurrent (mA), RXPower (dBm), TXPower (dBm), TransceiverTemperature (degC), SupplyVoltage (mV) - all reported as xsd:string. Forum 3447 maps productClass F670L to ...WANDevice.1.X_ZTE-COM_WANPONInterfaceConfig.RXPower and forum 5925 maps F670L to ...WANIPConnection.2.X_ZTE-COM_VLANID (instance .2 as observed; .1 used for the ServiceList/VLANEnable entries whose base path is stated in the same thread).

genieacs-relay paths/vendors/huawei.yaml lists product_class EG8145V5 (OUIs 00E0FC / 4C1FCC) and maps optical diagnostics to InternetGatewayDevice.X_HW_DEBUG.AdminTR069 (TxPower, RxPower only - optical.go notes Huawei usually does not expose bias/temp/voltage there). Forum 5925 EG8145V5 case uses ...WANConnectionDevice.2.WANIPConnection.1.X_HW_VLAN and ...UserInterface.X_HW_WebUserInfo.1.UserName.

Forum 3447 switch-case maps productClass HG8546M to InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.1.X_GponInterafceConfig.RXPower and the same thread declares ...X_GponInterafceConfig.TXPower for Huawei ONTs. Forum 7365 (HG8546M bootstrap script) uses basePath ...WANConnectionDevice.2.WANIPConnection with X_HW_SERVICELIST and X_HW_VLAN. Forum 2292 shows WLANConfiguration KeyPassphrase in the HG8546M TR-069 parameter list.

genieacs-relay paths/vendors/fiberhome.yaml lists product_class HG6243C (OUIs 0019E0 / 241815) and states: FiberHome ONTs generally follow TR-098 standard paths for PPPoE / DMZ / port-forwarding; no vendor overrides - optical paths inherit default.yaml. So every parameter below is the standard TR-098 path. No public dump of X_FH_* extensions for HG6243C was found; X_FH_* paths are verified on the sibling HG6143D (see model fiberhome-hg6143d).

genieacs-relay paths/vendors/fiberhome.yaml lists product_class AN5506-04-FA / AN5506-04-F / AN5506-04-FS (OUIs 0019E0 / 241815) and states FiberHome ONTs follow standard TR-098 paths with no vendor overrides. Parameters below are the standard TR-098 paths from that baseline.

Forum 7384 is a provisioning script that runs when productClass is HG6143D; it declares the X_FH_* extensions below on ...WANConnectionDevice.2.WANPPPConnection (instance auto-assigned, catalog uses .1) and the remote-web-login paths on InternetGatewayDevice. ...WANConnectionDevice.2.X_FH_WANGponLinkConfig is an object (no child parameters were printed in the source, so it is not listed as a parameter here).

Forum 3447 switch-case maps productClass 'G-140W-F' (G-140W family) to InternetGatewayDevice.X_ALU_OntOpticalParam.RXPower for reading Nokia ONT Rx power. TXPower was not present in the source, so it is not listed. Remaining parameters are the standard TR-098 baseline.

CAVEAT: no public source with parameter paths for the G-2426G-A itself was found. InternetGatewayDevice.X_ALU_OntOpticalParam.RXPower is verified in forum 3447 on the sibling Alcatel-Lucent/Nokia ONTs G-2425G-A and G-140W-F (same X_ALU_ vendor subtree); treat it as a family path and confirm against the device before GPV. Other parameters are the standard TR-098 baseline.

genieacs-relay paths/vendors/tp-link.yaml lists product_class XC220-G3v (OUIs B0BE76 / 50C7BF / 48A2E6). Forum 7219 is a TR-181 provisioning script for this ONT and declares the X_TP_* extensions below with instance numbers 4 / 8 / 3 (instances vary per device; catalog keeps the source values). The script binds Device.X_TP_GPON.Link.4.LowerLayers to Device.Optical.Interface.1, which is why the standard optical path is included.

The designation 'GPT-2541GAC' returns no results in any source; the real Mitrastar HGU is GPT-2541GNAC (forum 1910, a Movistar-issued GPT-2541GNAC). In that thread the PPPoE WAN MAC address is read from InternetGatewayDevice.WANDevice.1.WANConnectionDevice.1.WANPPPConnection.*.MACAddress (catalog uses instance .1). Other parameters are the standard TR-098 baseline.

CAVEAT: no public source containing TR-069 parameter paths for FG824CW exists; the Sercomm FG824 family ONT that is publicly documented is the FG824CD (Vodafone/Lowi, see the Sercomm FG824CD datasheet: https://www.drinia.tech/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Sercomm-FG824CD-Datasheet_20221128.pdf). Therefore only the TR-098 mandatory baseline paths are listed (any TR-069 CPE must expose DeviceInfo / ManagementServer, and default.yaml supplies the PPPoE credential template). Confirm against a live device before use.

Forum 5815 (and 6008) show a D-Link router exposing the vendor subtree InternetGatewayDevice.UserInterface.X_DLINK_RU_CustomRemoteAccess.{i}; the source declares the four parameters below via SetParameterValues with explicit types (IPAddress xsd:string, Protocol xsd:string, PublicPort xsd:unsignedInt, Enable xsd:boolean), so access is readWrite. The D-Link model name is not stated in the source - productClass is therefore null.

halny.com TR-069 knowledge base prints the HL-4GMV node tree: X_HALNY_Bind_* on ...WANConnectionDevice.2.WANIPConnection.1 (boolean, observed false) and ...WANConnectionDevice.2.X_CT-COM_WANGponLinkConfig with Enable=true, Mode=2, VLANIDMark=400, 802-1pMark=0. Values shown are the examples printed in that document.
